guidelines.detail: same as LRN-012 (The description explicitly makes receiving pre-travel reminders optional. That supports modeling a choice before the activity; it does not support the parallel-gateway flows, which imply execution or synchronization not stated in the description. The reference flow in F9 places the gateway after the receive activity, so its placement should not be copied as the rule.)

same as LRN-015 (The label pairs show differences in action, actor, and scope. The description provides the details needed to keep activity labels faithful, and learned guideline LRN-015 already expresses this principle.)

same as LRN-012 (The description makes both the reminders and post-travel services optional, and the records show the corresponding reference flows are absent. The learned guideline LRN-012 already expresses this modeling guidance.)

same as LRN-015 (The label pairs show that some generated labels retain actions or details stated in the description that the reference labels omit. Those details are supported by the description, so preserving them is appropriate; the learned guideline LRN-015 already expresses this principle.)

same as LRN-015 (The label pairs show differences in how much of the described action or outcome is represented, including alternatives and details such as payment, route selection, and reminders with instructions. The description supports preserving those material distinctions, and LRN-015 already expresses this principle.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an additional activity may be performed.: Model that activity on an optional branch, preserving its connection to the subsequent flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an activity may occur

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable. Preserve materially stated actions, alternatives, and objects or participants; do not substitute a broader or different action or add unsupported details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies an activity with a specific action, object, recipient, or scope

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a process has a completion point but an optional activity may occur afterward: Model an exclusive gateway that routes either through the optional activity and then to an appropriate end event, or directly to that end event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a process has a completion point but an optional activity may occur afterward
